# RelayAI

> Business automation for Australian small and medium businesses. Based in Adelaide, SA.

RelayAI builds custom automations and AI agents for Australian SMBs. We work across industries including trades, allied health, professional services, retail, and hospitality. Everything we build is bespoke — designed around each client's existing tools and workflows, not the other way around.

## What We Build

- **Workflow automation** — trigger-based automations that connect your existing apps (e.g. when a form is submitted → create a job in your CRM → send a confirmation SMS)
- **AI agents** — conversational agents that handle inbound enquiries via WhatsApp, SMS, email, or web chat; book appointments, answer questions, qualify leads, and escalate to humans when needed
- **Document processing** — extract structured data from invoices, quotes, intake forms, PDFs, and emails
- **System integrations** — connect your CRM, calendar, accounting software, and communication channels
- **Automated reporting** — scheduled summaries, KPI alerts, and data exports delivered to Slack, email, or your preferred tool
- **Scheduled automations** — cron-based jobs that run daily/weekly tasks without manual intervention

## Technology

We use the right tool for each job — n8n for deterministic workflow automation, custom Python/FastAPI services for AI agents and complex logic, and direct API integrations with tools like Xero, HubSpot, Google Workspace, Twilio (WhatsApp/SMS), Meta (Messenger/Instagram), Calendly, and others.

Underlying AI uses Anthropic Claude models for reliability and safety.

## Who We Serve

Australian SMBs with 2–50 staff who are spending too much time on manual, repetitive tasks. Common clients include:

- **Trades businesses** — after-hours enquiry handling, quote follow-up, job scheduling, invoice processing
- **Allied health practices** — appointment booking, patient intake, practitioner scheduling (Splose-compatible)
- **Professional services** — lead qualification, document processing, client onboarding automation
- **Retail and e-commerce** — order management, supplier integrations, customer communication

## Pricing

Custom scoping for every engagement. Typically structured as a setup fee plus a small monthly retainer for maintenance and support. We don't sell subscriptions to generic platforms — we build and maintain solutions specific to your business.

## Location

Adelaide, South Australia, Australia. We work with businesses across Australia remotely.
